source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The fixed command and menu code allows the online case or a folder whose server has no offline-support requirement. Multi-selection combines that condition across folders. The original landing accidentally uses AND inside one accumulation while using OR elsewhere; fixed accepted code uses OR there too. Do not copy that historical expression as the intended contract. The changed test hunks assert new-folder dialog focus and initial values, not this offline matrix. Hardware airplane mode with Thunderbird still online remains a different condition. No runtime offline behavior was tested.
title: Offline folder gates combine application state with local-folder capability
